# Fixtures

`game-scoutbot-sample.log` is built line for line in the prefix shapes of real
`Logs/game-*.log` files from Scrap Mechanic 1.0.1.869 on Jordy's PC: the
four-part `[Thread] [Lua]` form, the three-part form warnings use, CRLF and LF
endings, and broken reports that must be skipped. A recording from a patched
game replaces it once Phase 1 is tested in game.
